Overhaul v1.2.0b (2 April 2021) |previous_update = [[Overhaul v1.1|Halloween 2020 Update]] |next_update = [[Overhaul v1.3|Frost Invasion Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Overhaul v1.2''' was the twenty-seventh update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 1st of April 2021. This update is notable for being an April Fools update, bringing the [[Imposter]] to the game. As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''Overhaul v1.2''' has been retroactively applied to this update. However, since this update was an April Fools update, it can also be called, '''April Fools 2021 Update'''. The version encompassed three updates, the main Overhaul v1.2.0 update (released 1 April 2021) and two minor updates, the Overhaul v1.2.0a (released on the same day as Overhaul v1.2.0, 1 April 2021) and Overhaul v1.2.0b (released 2 April 2021). ==Additions== *[[Imposter]] *[[Badges|Suspicious...]] achievement badge ==Removals== :In '''Overhaul v1.2.0b''': *[[Imposter]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode wave 1 now spawns one [[Imposter]]. *[[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode wave 1 dialogue changed. :In '''Overhaul v1.2.0a''': *Fast enemies and units no longer get stuck on the first bridge in [[Autumn Falling]] in all modes except [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. :In '''Overhaul v1.2.0b''': *[[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode wave 1 no longer spawns one [[Imposter]]. *[[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode wave 1 dialogue changes reverted. *[[Badges|Suspicious...]] badge is no longer obtainable. {{UpdateNavBox}} [[Category:Overhaul Updates]] [[Category:April Fools Updates]]
